resources.string: Your own AmneziaWG server, deployed from the app over SSH. The SSH password is never saved; only the server key fingerprint is pinned.
No servers yet. You need a VPS with Debian/Ubuntu (root, systemd) reachable over SSH.
Or private SSH key (text, instead of password)
Open the port in ufw/firewalld (only if the firewall is on)
1.0: Jc, Jmin, Jmax, S1, S2, H1–H4. Works with any AmneziaWG client.
1.5: parameters as in 1.0 (signature packets I1–I5 are not set); compatible with 1.0 and 1.5 clients.
2.0: + S3, S4 and H1–H4 ranges. Needs a 2.0+ client (Hydra is fine).
3.x: + HeaderProtectionKey, content padding, random trailers. Needs a 3.x client (Hydra is fine).
SSH host key fingerprint. Compare it with your hosting panel (or run ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub on the server); later connections are allowed only with this key.
Server: %1$s · %2$s · root=%3$s · systemd=%4$s · port free=%5$s · internet=%6$s · firewall=%7$s
What will be run on the server:
The hydra-awg service, config and AmneziaWG binaries will be stopped and removed on %1$s. Client profiles will stop working.
Sign in to %1$s@%2$s:%3$d (credentials are not saved)
A .conf file: Hydra imports it directly; the official AmneziaWG app takes it as a file.
The exit node is installed with the official “own node” wizard script (pinned commit, SHA-256 checked); the script picks the port. Yandex / Mail.ru transports are optional, direct is always on.
The OpenFlux node channel, its service and config will be removed on %1$s. Profiles using this node will stop working.
